config.applefix.title: AppleFix
config.applefix.cancel.tooltip: Forgets pending changes and closes the settings.
config.applefix.reset.tooltip: Resets all options to default. (This can be undone!)
config.applefix.undo.tooltip: Reverts all options to what they were before editing.
options.applefix.reverseScrolling.descri: Reverses the scroll direction everywhere: menus, lists and the hotbar.
Reverses which way scrolling moves the hotbar selection. Menus are not affected.
options.applefix.lockHotbarScrolling.des: Ignores scrolling while you hold Attack or Use, so a brushed trackpad or Magic Mouse does not switch items mid-fight or mid-build.
options.applefix.momentumScrolling.descr: Menus and lists keep gliding after you lift your fingers, like other Mac apps. Takes effect after restarting the game.
options.applefix.hotbarMomentum.descript: Lets the glide after a trackpad swipe move the hotbar selection too. Off: the hotbar only moves while your fingers are on the trackpad. Needs Momentum Scrolling.
options.applefix.trackpadHotbarSpeed.des: How fast trackpad and Magic Mouse scrolling moves through the hotbar. Lower it if a swipe skips items. Mouse wheels are not affected.
